kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
هررت (form I)
# هَرَرْتُ (harartu) /ha.rar.tu/: first-person singular past active of هَرَّ (harra)
# هَرَرْتَ (hararta) /ha.rar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of هَرَّ (harra)
# هَرَرْتِ (hararti) /ha.rar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of هَرَّ (harra)
# هُرِرْتُ (hurirtu) /hu.rir.tu/: first-person singular past passive of هَرَّ (harra) and هُرَّ (hurra)
# هُرِ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
